description: This module gathers information on a specific system using its HP iLO interface. These information includes hardware and network related information useful for provisioning (for example macaddress, uuid).

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The HP iLO hostname/address that is linked to the physical system.

parameters.name: login
parameters.description: The login name to authenticate to the HP iLO interface. Default: "Administrator"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password to authenticate to the HP iLO interface. Default: "admin"

examples:
- name: Gather facts from a HP iLO interface only if the system is an HP server
  community.general.hpilo_info:
    host: YOUR_ILO_ADDRESS
    login: YOUR_ILO_LOGIN
    password: YOUR_ILO_PASSWORD
  when: cmdb_hwmodel.startswith('HP ')
  delegate_to: localhost
  register: results

- ansible.builtin.fail:
    msg: 'CMDB serial ({{ cmdb_serialno }}) does not match hardware serial ({{ results.hw_system_serial }}) !'
  when: cmdb_serialno != results.hw_system_serial

return_values.name: host_power_status
return_values.description: Power status of host. It is one of ON, OFF and UNKNOWN. Returned: always Sample: "ON"

return_values.name: hw_eth_ilo
return_values.description: Interface information (for the iLO network interface). Returned: always Sample: [{"macaddress": "00:11:22:33:44:BA"}, {"macaddress_dash": "00-11-22-33-44-BA"}]

return_values.name: hw_ethX
return_values.description: Interface information (for each interface). Returned: always Sample: [{"macaddress": "00:11:22:33:44:55", "macaddress_dash": "00-11-22-33-44-55"}]

return_values.name: hw_product_name
return_values.description: Product name. Returned: always Sample: "ProLiant DL360 G7"

return_values.name: hw_system_serial
return_values.description: System serial number. Returned: always Sample: "ABC12345D6"
